bridge.en: Imagine an ordinary gym: the reception counter, the entrance, people arriving with bags over their shoulders. In the fictional scene you will read, a runner collapses and those familiar surroundings become important information. Farid wants to understand where a caller, an equipment request and responder access fit together. CPR and an AED are connected parts of adult emergency response, but their names alone do not coordinate a team. Basic adult targets remain plainly stated here; a screen cannot assess compression quality or replace supervised practice on suitable training equipment.
bridge.ms: Bayangkan gim biasa: kaunter penerimaan, pintu masuk dan orang yang tiba dengan beg di bahu. Dalam gambaran rekaan yang akan anda baca, seorang pelari rebah dan persekitaran yang biasa itu menjadi maklumat penting. Farid mahu memahami hubungan antara pemanggil, permintaan peralatan dan akses petugas bantuan. CPR dan AED ialah bahagian berkaitan dalam tindak balas kecemasan dewasa, tetapi menyebut namanya sahaja tidak menyelaraskan pasukan. Sasaran asas dewasa kekal dinyatakan dengan jelas di sini; skrin tidak dapat menilai kualiti tekanan dada atau menggantikan latihan terselia menggunakan peralatan sesuai.

title.en: A gym team needs usable information

options: Checking that a message was heard
questions.prompt: Which team communication habit would you practise?
questions.promptMs: Tabiat komunikasi berpasukan manakah yang ingin anda latih?

questions.prompt: What would help you plan qualified practical training?
questions.promptMs: Apakah yang dapat membantu anda merancang latihan amali di bawah bimbingan pengajar berkelayakan?

options.en: Naming the listener directs the message to someone specific rather than the whole crowd.
options.ms: Menamakan penerima mengarahkan mesej kepada orang tertentu, bukan seluruh orang ramai.

options.en: Acknowledgement confirms the message was heard; an update confirms its status.
options.ms: Pengesahan menunjukkan mesej didengar; maklumat susulan menjelaskan statusnya.

options.en: Clarification prevents people acting on different assumptions about the task.
options.ms: Penjelasan mengelakkan orang bertindak berdasarkan andaian berbeza tentang tugas.

options.en: Ask what demonstration, equipment and feedback the session includes.
options.ms: Tanya demonstrasi, peralatan dan maklum balas yang disediakan.

options.en: A realistic time and place can make training easier to attend.
options.ms: Masa dan tempat realistik boleh memudahkan kehadiran latihan.

options.en: Explain the adjustment that helps participation; accessibility is a legitimate learning need.
options.ms: Jelaskan penyesuaian yang membantu penyertaan; kebolehcapaian ialah keperluan pembelajaran yang sah.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: CPR supports circulation; AED analyses rhythm; Prompts guide use.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: CPR menyokong peredaran; AED menganalisis ritma; Arahan membimbing penggunaan.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: At a later learning session, Farid asks, “What does each part contribute?” It is a better place to begin than imagining a machine solves everything. CPR supports circulation during cardiac arrest; an AED analyses the heart rhythm and advises or delivers a shock when appropriate. It does not shock every person. The device arriving does not mean the emergency has ended. Its prompts and the coordination of help matter together.
paragraphs.ms: Dalam sesi pembelajaran kemudian, Farid bertanya, “Apakah peranan setiap bahagian?” Itu permulaan yang lebih berguna daripada membayangkan mesin menyelesaikan semuanya. CPR menyokong peredaran darah semasa henti jantung; AED menganalisis ritma jantung dan mengarahkan atau memberikan kejutan apabila sesuai. Ia tidak memberikan kejutan kepada semua orang. Ketibaan alat tidak bermakna kecemasan selesai. Arahan alat dan penyelarasan bantuan saling penting.

paragraphs.en: Knowing what equipment does differs from demonstrating its use. A practical session can provide a manikin, AED trainer and instructor feedback. Do not take an operational AED out of service for an online exercise: it may be needed by someone facing a real emergency. An explanation can make a role clearer while leaving practical instruction with the right equipment and guidance.
paragraphs.ms: Mengetahui fungsi alat berbeza daripada menunjukkan penggunaannya. Sesi amali boleh menyediakan manikin, AED latihan dan maklum balas pengajar. Jangan keluarkan AED sebenar daripada perkhidmatan bagi latihan dalam talian kerana mungkin diperlukan dalam kecemasan sebenar. Penerangan boleh menjelaskan peranan sambil mengekalkan keperluan bimbingan amali dan peralatan yang sesuai.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Adult recognition; CPR within guidance; Follow device prompts.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Kenali tanda kecemasan dewasa; CPR mengikut panduan; Ikuti arahan alat.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: For an unresponsive adult not breathing normally, call 999 and begin CPR with chest compressions. An untrained responder, or someone unable or unwilling to give breaths, can provide continuous compressions. A trained, willing responder can use 30 compressions followed by two breaths. “Hands-only” means compressions without breaths, not 30:2.
paragraphs.ms: Bagi dewasa tidak responsif yang tidak bernafas normal, hubungi 999 dan mulakan CPR dengan tekanan dada. Orang tidak terlatih atau tidak mampu atau tidak mahu memberikan bantuan pernafasan boleh melakukan tekanan berterusan. Orang terlatih yang bersedia boleh menggunakan 30 tekanan diikuti dua bantuan pernafasan. “Hands-only” bermaksud tekanan tanpa bantuan pernafasan, bukan 30:2.

paragraphs.en: Adult targets are 100–120 compressions per minute, at least 5 cm deep while avoiding more than 6 cm, full recoil and minimal pauses. Hands are placed on the lower half of the breastbone. These are awareness targets, not permission to practise on a person; safe assessment requires suitable training equipment and instruction.
paragraphs.ms: Sasaran dewasa ialah 100–120 tekanan seminit, sekurang-kurangnya 5 cm sambil mengelakkan kedalaman melebihi 6 cm, dada kembali sepenuhnya dan jeda minimum. Tangan diletakkan pada separuh bawah tulang dada. Ini sasaran kesedaran, bukan kebenaran berlatih pada seseorang; penilaian selamat memerlukan peralatan latihan dan bimbingan sesuai.

paragraphs.en: Switch on the AED and follow its voice prompts and pad diagrams. Keep everyone clear during analysis and any shock, then resume CPR when directed. Breaths are especially important in drowning and other oxygen-related emergencies; children and infants need their own training pathway. No positioning, pad-placement or breathing-technique illustration is provided here.
paragraphs.ms: Hidupkan AED dan ikuti arahan suara serta rajah padnya. Pastikan semua orang tidak menyentuh mangsa semasa analisis atau kejutan, kemudian sambung CPR apabila diarahkan. Bantuan pernafasan amat penting dalam kejadian lemas dan kecemasan kekurangan oksigen; kanak-kanak serta bayi memerlukan laluan latihan sendiri. Tiada ilustrasi posisi, penempatan pad atau teknik pernafasan di sini.

alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Pemanggil; Sokongan peralatan; Laluan petugas.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.

title.en: See support roles in the gym

paragraphs.en: Return to the gym on the page. Its entrance and reception desk now connect people with different responsibilities. A fictional runner collapses in a gym with an AED near reception. One person contacts emergency help, another is asked to retrieve the device and a third can guide responders through the entrance. Each named request and update makes the support roles clearer.
paragraphs.ms: Kembali kepada gim dalam bacaan. Pintu masuk dan kaunter penerimaannya kini menghubungkan orang dengan tanggungjawab yang berbeza. Pelari rekaan rebah di gimnasium dengan AED berhampiran kaunter penerimaan. Seorang menghubungi bantuan, seorang diminta mengambil alat dan seorang lagi boleh menunjukkan laluan kepada petugas. Setiap permintaan khusus dan maklumat susulan menjelaskan peranan sokongan.

paragraphs.en: Those roles do not prove that equipment is immediately accessible or everyone is trained. A locked reception area or misunderstood entrance changes the support task. Describe the obstacle and seek guidance rather than inventing a successful outcome because the story mentions that an AED exists. In a discussion afterwards, “Was access confirmed?” becomes a useful question rather than an accusation.
paragraphs.ms: Peranan itu tidak membuktikan alat boleh dicapai segera atau semua orang terlatih. Kaunter berkunci atau pintu masuk yang disalah faham mengubah tugas sokongan. Terangkan halangan dan dapatkan panduan, bukannya menganggap hasil berjaya kerana cerita menyebut adanya AED. Dalam perbincangan selepas itu, “Adakah akses telah disahkan?” menjadi soalan berguna dan bukannya tuduhan.

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Learning target; Observed attempt; Specific feedback.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Sasaran pembelajaran; Cubaan diperhatikan; Maklum balas khusus.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.

title.ms: Fahami perkara yang diukur maklum balas latihan

paragraphs.en: Picture a quiet conversation after an instructor-supervised attempt, when the learner can listen to feedback without needing to impress the room. Imagine an instructor reviewing practice on a feedback manikin. Rate, depth, recoil and pauses can be discussed using observations from that session. A number copied from reading is a target; a result shown by training equipment is evidence about an attempt. They should not be confused.
paragraphs.ms: Bayangkan perbualan tenang selepas percubaan yang diselia pengajar, apabila pelajar boleh mendengar maklum balas tanpa perlu mengagumkan orang lain. Bayangkan pengajar menyemak latihan menggunakan manikin bermaklum balas. Kadar, kedalaman, pengembalian dada dan jeda boleh dibincangkan berdasarkan sesi itu. Nombor daripada bacaan ialah sasaran; bacaan alat latihan ialah bukti tentang cubaan. Kedua-duanya tidak patut disamakan.

paragraphs.en: Useful feedback explains what to repeat and why. This mission therefore records no personal performance figures and shows no imitation technique. Questions about breaths, pad placement and different ages belong in qualified practical instruction, with appropriate equipment and enough time to clarify uncertainty. Specific feedback gives the next attempt a purpose; the feeling of confidence alone cannot do that.
paragraphs.ms: Maklum balas berguna menjelaskan perkara yang perlu diulang dan sebabnya. Oleh itu, misi ini tidak merekodkan angka prestasi atau menunjukkan teknik untuk ditiru. Soalan tentang pernafasan, penempatan pad dan umur berbeza memerlukan latihan berkelayakan dengan peralatan sesuai dan masa untuk penjelasan. Maklum balas khusus memberi tujuan kepada percubaan seterusnya; rasa yakin sahaja tidak dapat berbuat demikian.

title.ms: Fahami perkara yang diukur maklum balas latihan

alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Lokasi diketahui; Akses disahkan; Latihan sesuai.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.

title.en: Make training and access information usable
title.ms: Jadikan maklumat latihan dan akses berguna

paragraphs.en: Farid realises that “near reception” is the beginning of an enquiry, not its complete answer. One readiness step is asking the responsible person where an AED is located and when the area is accessible. Looking for an approved sign differs from opening, moving or testing the device. “There is an AED” does not explain how someone reaches it.
paragraphs.ms: Farid menyedari bahawa “berhampiran kaunter penerimaan” ialah permulaan pertanyaan, bukannya jawapan lengkap. Satu langkah kesediaan ialah bertanya kepada pihak bertanggungjawab tentang lokasi AED dan waktu kawasan boleh diakses. Mencari papan tanda rasmi berbeza daripada membuka, mengalihkan atau menguji alat. “Ada AED” tidak menjelaskan cara seseorang mendapatkannya.

paragraphs.en: Another option is enquiring about practical training that fits your language, schedule or accessibility needs. No purchase or booking is required to finish this reading. A manageable question is more useful than a long promise you cannot carry out or a course form containing private circumstances. A modest enquiry can make an assumption visible and leave a clear question for the responsible person.
paragraphs.ms: Pilihan lain ialah bertanya tentang latihan amali sesuai dengan bahasa, jadual atau kebolehcapaian. Tiada pembelian atau tempahan diperlukan untuk menamatkan bacaan. Soalan yang mampu diurus lebih berguna daripada janji panjang yang sukar dilaksanakan atau borang kursus mengandungi keadaan peribadi. Pertanyaan sederhana boleh memperlihatkan andaian dan menyediakan soalan jelas untuk pihak yang bertanggungjawab.

title.en: Make training and access information usable
title.ms: Jadikan maklumat latihan dan akses berguna

alt.en: Three labelled ideas: Respectful questions; Clear responsibilities; Honest limits.
alt.ms: Tiga idea berlabel: Soalan menghormati; Tanggungjawab jelas; Batas yang jujur.

caption.en: Compare these three ideas alongside the reading. This is a conceptual learning map, not a treatment diagram.
caption.ms: Bandingkan tiga idea ini bersama bacaan. Ini ialah peta konsep pembelajaran, bukan rajah rawatan.

paragraphs.en: A learner pauses before asking the instructor a question. Someone beside them waits without interrupting. That small courtesy gives the question room. A first practical session can bring worry about making mistakes. Clear expectations and respectful feedback help turn that worry into a question an instructor can address. Asking for an explanation or an accessibility adjustment does not make someone less committed to helping other people.
paragraphs.ms: Seorang pelajar terhenti sebelum bertanya kepada pengajar. Orang di sebelahnya menunggu tanpa mencelah. Kesopanan kecil itu memberi ruang kepada soalan. Sesi amali pertama boleh menimbulkan kebimbangan melakukan kesilapan. Jangkaan jelas dan maklum balas menghormati membantu menukar kebimbangan kepada soalan untuk pengajar. Meminta penerangan atau penyesuaian kebolehcapaian tidak bermakna seseorang kurang komited membantu orang lain.

paragraphs.en: The gym example shows that communication and treatment are related but distinct responsibilities. You might explain a support role clearly while still needing instruction for a physical skill. Keep that distinction. Completion records awareness learning, not a judgement that you can perform CPR safely. You can be serious about helping and still say, “I need to learn that properly.”
paragraphs.ms: Contoh gimnasium menunjukkan komunikasi dan rawatan berkaitan tetapi tanggungjawabnya berbeza. Anda mungkin menjelaskan peranan sokongan dengan jelas tetapi masih memerlukan bimbingan kemahiran fizikal. Kekalkan perbezaan itu. Penyelesaian merekodkan kesedaran, bukan keputusan bahawa anda mampu melakukan CPR dengan selamat. Anda boleh bersungguh-sungguh mahu membantu dan tetap berkata, “Saya perlu mempelajarinya dengan betul.”
